svg.title: Wenyi Chen · Gonzalo Landscape · From yard to quote
svg.desc: Three-stage product walkthrough. The website prepares Maya’s quote. Three gallery photos are attached inside her unsent iPhone draft; the separate owner screen illustrates the conversation after she taps Send.

g.inkscape:label: Gonzalo Landscape case study
g.text: GONZALO LANDSCAPE / PRO BONO CLIENT PROJECT

text.tspan: A website for a landscaping business built
around the way Gonzalo already quotes jobs.

g.text: Illustrative request from Maya · Austin, Texas

g.data-name: Three stages of the quote request
g.inkscape:label: Three stages of the quote request
Website · customer view
Website — quote form
g.text: Nothing sends until you tap Send.
The form opens a prepared text addressed to Gonzalo.

g.inkscape:label: Maya’s iPhone — unsent draft

g.data-name: One unsent composer containing photos and editable text
g.inkscape:label: One unsent composer containing photos and editable text

text.tspan: Hi, my name is Maya. I would like a quote for
patio construction and yard cleanup, overgrowth
removal, and haul-away. The property is at
78745. Property details: Side gate is narrow. I
will attach yard photos to this text.

g.text: Three photos are attached. Maya can still edit or cancel.

g.data-name: Gonzalo’s iPhone — after the customer sends
g.inkscape:label: Gonzalo’s iPhone — after the customer sends

text.tspan: Hi, my name is Maya. I would like a quote for
patio construction and yard cleanup, overgrowth
removal, and haul-away. The property is at

g.inkscape:label: Gonzalo’s illustrative reply
g.text: ¿Puedo pasar mañana para ver el jardín?
After Send, Gonzalo can translate the text and reply.

g.inkscape:label: Case study caption
g.text: Give Gonzalo the job details and the photos in the same conversation.
